proposal_revisions_split_valid.name: proposal_revisions_split_valid
proposal_revisions_split_valid.value: "proposal_revisions"."creator_split_pct" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "proposal_revisions"."builder_split_pct" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "proposal_revisions"."creator_split_pct" + "proposal_revisions"."builder_split_pct" = 100

threads_kind_matches_parent.name: threads_kind_matches_parent
threads_kind_matches_parent.value: ("threads"."kind" = 'proposal' AND "threads"."proposal_id" IS NOT NULL AND "threads"."collab_id" IS NULL) OR ("threads"."kind" = 'collab' AND "threads"."collab_id" IS NOT NULL AND "threads"."proposal_id" IS NULL)

launches_complete_unless_draft.name: launches_complete_unless_draft
launches_complete_unless_draft.value: "launches"."status" = 'draft' OR ("launches"."price_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "launches"."delivery_type" IS NOT NULL)

audience_snapshots_countries_have_basis.name: audience_snapshots_countries_have_basis
audience_snapshots_countries_have_basis.value: "audience_snapshots"."countries_basis" IS NOT NULL OR "audience_snapshots"."top_countries" IS NULL OR jsonb_array_length("audience_snapshots"."top_countries") = 0

social_connections_manual_has_no_tokens.name: social_connections_manual_has_no_tokens
social_connections_manual_has_no_tokens.value: "social_connections"."source" <> 'manual' OR ("social_connections"."access_token_enc" IS NULL AND "social_connections"."refresh_token_enc" IS NULL)

social_connections_sync_error_has_time.name: social_connections_sync_error_has_time
social_connections_sync_error_has_time.value: "social_connections"."last_sync_error" IS NULL OR "social_connections"."last_sync_error_at" IS NOT NULL

ledger_entries_share_has_user.name: ledger_entries_share_has_user
ledger_entries_share_has_user.value: "ledger_entries"."account" NOT IN ('creator_share', 'builder_share') OR "ledger_entries"."user_id" IS NOT NULL
